name: scale_pilot
limitations: Data are synthetic: absolute predictive numbers have no biological meaning and do not transfer to a real cohort.
This scale tests local CPU memory and runtime, not whether an approved cohort has enough donors or paired cells.
The larger donor count narrows synthetic donor intervals but does not establish a power calculation for a real study.
Model selection uses validation only; the test split is evaluated once per model and seed.
Routing weights are signals about fused representations, not causal explanations.
No approved real dataset is present, and no condition-specific result is produced.
